I1 the plan carries behavior: RenderFramePlan holds recordCompose / recordBeforeExtensions / recordExtensions / appendCapture as std::function capturing App& and dt, so the real record order lives half in GameRuntimeTickOrchestrator::recordFrame and half in RenderFrameCoordinator::record, and a missing step is silent because ViewComposeInput::empty and Extensions::empty only ask whether a callback exists

I2 four answers to the primary view: declareViews() primaryView (viewFeatures), viewFrames.front() (frameData, where index 0 = host camera is a pairViewFrames ordering convention), plan.sceneRender.displayRootTask() (display root and publish), and publishFamilyResult looping over SceneViewFamilyPlan writing _publishedOutputViewId so the last view written wins

I3 fallback chains hide ownership errors: getActiveViewportImageShared falls back to pipelineViewportColorImage; getViewOutput(viewId) scans every flight after the published one; getViewportExtent has four sources (published, _pipelineViewportRect, active pipeline, empty); buildPipelineDebugOutputCatalog assembles two different catalogs depending on whether a view was published

I4 record() mutates before begin() (prepareDerivedState, applyPendingMutations, applyViewportResize, prepareComposePipelines, prepareRender2DComposePassPipeline), so the safe point is the unwritten convention everything-before-beginFrameCommandBuffer

I5 IRenderRuntimeServices lets a pass reach global state mid-record: host tick, gameplay binding, env lighting processor, debug render system, scene skybox and env descriptor sets, resolveSceneEnvironmentLightingResources

I6 offscreen work is pumped as a side effect of tickRender (OffscreenTaskService::tick with AppTaskManager as IOffscreenTaskScheduler), so when offscreen products become available is not readable from a declaration

I7 RenderDeviceState.ViewportDebug.cpp is 652 lines of panel-facing debug catalog (category constants, signature hash, mutable cache) hanging off the device, and Render3D still includes GUI/Compose/Render2DComposePass.h

root shared by I2 and I3: view identity is a global small integer (kPrimarySceneViewId = 1 in both producers, kEditorPreviewViewId = 2 in the editor) and viewId == 0 doubles as no-view and never-published, which is why owner-scoped SceneViewKey (checkpoint 5) waits until after V2

slice order: V1-V3 in one commit (delete the duplicate primary-view answers, make publish explicit, delete the fallback chains) because they change no GPU timing and establish the ground V5 needs; V4+V5 together because the IRenderRuntimeServices env-lighting outlet is what PreparedView takes over and splitting them leaves a half-migrated state; V6/V7/V8 independent
every fix is deletion (delete front(), the loop assignment, the fallbacks, the callbacks, the intermediate structs); no new bus, registry or central scheduler

V1-V3 landed 2026-09-19: the host-viewport View has one definition, authority is SceneViewDesc::ownsHostViewport (structural) rather than viewId == kPrimarySceneViewId, and kPrimarySceneViewId returns to its real meaning as the camera preview inset's compose target

V1 deleted: the id search in declareViews, viewFrames.front() in buildGameRenderFrame, displayRootTask()'s viewportTasks.front() fallback, sceneViewOwnsHostViewport(nullptr) meaning owns, primaryTask() as a second name for displayRootTask(), and in both Forward and Deferred the recordings.empty() View synthesis plus the bDisplayRoot || result.views.empty() output fallback (spellings of the same implicit rule that the audit had not registered; the empty-recordings path had no production caller or test, so it went as legacy)
V1 added ExtractedSceneRender::hostFrameData(), set by pairViewFrames for the task that owns the host viewport, so the host camera packet no longer reads pairing slot 0

V2 added publishViewOutputIdentity(flightIndex, displayViewId) as the single writer of _publishedOutputViewId (0 clears) and made publishFamilyResult publish outputs only, so the identity is no longer whichever family was recorded last
V2 also fixed a latent bug: a non-empty plan with no display root, or a display root with viewId 0, previously left the previous tick's identity in place readable as this tick's output
V2 deleted beginFrameCommandBuffer's stale-identity compensation, because publishedViewOutput() already resolves the identity against the live table and returns null when it is gone

V3 collapsed the accessors: getActiveViewportImageShared and getViewportDisplayImageShared read only the published View; getViewportExtent has two sources (published, then empty) instead of four; getViewOutput(viewId) no longer scans other flights; pipelineViewportDisplayImage() and pipelineViewportColorImage() are deleted as dead code once the fallbacks went

V3 callers already fall back explicitly: the editor sizes its 2D canvas from its own panel rect, resolveViewportExtent uses viewportRect then window size, and AppScreenshotCapture::request refuses an invalid source

V1-V3 evidence: ya-render-3d-test 176/176 (+2 new cases); the ya-testing render/editor filter is 265 passed / 3 failed against a stash baseline of 263 passed / the same 3 failed, so 0 regressions and +2 cases; HelloMaterial and run-editor at --exit-after-frame=90 --screenshot-target=viewport both exit 0 with 0 log errors, the runtime screenshot is byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (md5 1c6668976be1cdd5d755d1f1365700f7, 1395200 bytes), and the editor screenshot matches a same-session stash probe of the reverted code (md5 5b8f5dd8acdbc90bd5c383feb3f7bcec, 570289 bytes)

V1-V3 new cases pin the contract: EmptyDevicePublishesEmptyViewportResources answers null/0x0 for every host-viewport accessor before a display root is published, HostFrameDataFollowsTheDisplayRootNotThePairingSlot declares the overlay View first and still gets the display root's slot, and TickThatDeclaresNoDisplayRootHasNoHostFrameData pins the honest absence

still open: IRenderRuntimeServices (I5) and the CameraFrameInput split (V5) are untouched by design because they ship together; RenderFramePlan's std::function contributions (I1/V6) and the offscreen pump (I6/V7) are untouched; buildViewportSnapshot's else branch still reads pipeline depth and entityId handles, deliberately left to V8 instead of half-deleted here
V4-V5 landed 2026-09-19: IRenderRuntimeServices is gone and CameraFrameInput became FramePacket

V4a the clock is View data now: RenderFrameData gained timeSeconds (from ViewPrepareInput.elapsedTimeSeconds, which the host fills from HostViewState.clock.elapsedTimeMS) and the Forward lit/unlit passes read fd.frameIndex / fd.timeSeconds instead of asking a services interface

V4b scene resources are resolved before recording: RenderViewSceneResources (skybox DS, IBL DS, derived resources, env lighting processor) is filled once per View by RenderDeviceState::resolveViewSceneResources inside record() before beginFrameCommandBuffer, next to prepareDerivedState / applyPendingMutations / applyViewportResize; the Forward stage and Deferred overlay pass read frame.view.frameData->sceneResources

V4b EnvironmentLightingSceneResources moved out of EnvironmentLightingProcessor.h into Render3D/Common/EnvironmentLightingSceneResources.h because it is a result type, so EnvironmentLightingResultProvider.h no longer pulls in the whole processor (ECS components plus cubemap pipelines)
V4c DebugRenderSystem is a construction parameter of DeferredRenderInitDesc and PipelineCoordinator::InitDesc instead of a services accessor

V4d deleted: IRenderRuntimeServices.h, the base class on RenderDeviceState (concrete methods stay, override dropped), the dead getGameplayResourceBinding plus the App::getGameplayResourceBinding that only forwarded to it, and the _runtimeServices member plus InitDesc field plus forwarding chain in all five pass classes (AuxPasses' was assignment-only dead weight)

V5 deleted cameraForViewRecording and the whole per-view patching step; FramePacket holds only frame-level facts (flightIndex, frameIndex, deltaTime, viewportFrameBufferScale as the host render scale, shadowSettings, overlay, uiFrameSnapshot); RenderPipelineFrameContext.camera became const FramePacket* frame and every pipeline read moved to frame.view data

V5 deleted the now-unreachable 'view.frameData ? view.frameData : camera.frameData' fallbacks, because pairViewFrames guarantees every surviving View has its own prepared slot; collectViewOutput lost its camera parameter (it only used the View's extent); recordCameraViewCompose now takes (uiFrameSnapshot, logicalViewportExtent) with the coordinator using the display root's output.extent, the same value the camera copy used to carry

V5 kept on purpose: derivedScene (it already reads the Scene from that View's task, so it is not a patch), SceneViewRecording (task plus frameData pairing) and RenderViewRecordingContext (already View-level). Merging those two layers is P3 cleanup, and renaming RenderFrameData to PreparedViewRenderData belongs to P3's naming batch, because every field they carry has a real consumer today

V4-V5 evidence: rg for IRenderRuntimeServices | CameraFrameInput | runtimeServices | getGameplayResourceBinding across Engine and Example is empty; ya-render-3d-test 176/176; the ya-testing render/editor filter is 265 passed / 3 failed, identical to the V1-V3 baseline; both smoke screenshots are byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (runtime md5 1c6668976be1cdd5d755d1f1365700f7, editor md5 5b8f5dd8acdbc90bd5c383feb3f7bcec), and each of V4 and V5 was smoke-checked separately so 'V4 did not move pixels' and 'V5 did not move pixels' both hold

still open: RenderFramePlan's four std::function contributions (I1/V6), the offscreen pump inside tickRender (I6/V7), the viewport debug catalog hanging off the device (I7/V8) together with buildViewportSnapshot's else branch that still reads pipeline depth/entityId handles, and the two remaining View layers (P3)
V6 landed 2026-09-19: RenderFramePlan carries no behavior

V6 added Render3D/Common/FrameRecordExtensions.h with IFrameRecordExtensions: recordViewCompose, recordBeforeDisplayExtensions, recordDisplayExtensions, appendDisplayCapture, each a virtual with an empty default so 'this host records nothing here' is a legal frame (headless, UI-only)

V6 deleted PresentationGraphService::Extensions and DisplayComposeInput (two parallel descriptions of the same stages) and the four std::function members; recordDisplayCompose now takes IFrameRecordExtensions* directly and RenderFramePlan has one 'IFrameRecordExtensions* recordExtensions' pointer, so the std::function count in the plan is zero (the acceptance asked for at most one)

V6 ViewComposeInput keeps only the inset data; recordCameraViewCompose lost its viewCompose parameter (it existed only to call recordCompose) and the coordinator calls the View-compose stage right after it, at the same point in the sequence

V6 App implements IFrameRecordExtensions: the three recordModule* forwarders became the interface methods with the module loops inline, and appendDisplayCapture absorbed the two automation calls that used to be written in GameRuntimeTickOrchestrator, so the host no longer assembles any closures

V6 not done on purpose: no contributor span (there is one host, App; a span would add lifetime burden for no benefit, and swapping the pointer for a span later is local), and no 'assert when a stage is missing' (a headless or UI-only frame legitimately records nothing, so the assertion would fail legal frames). The honest statement is that every stage is called unconditionally and what happens at each is the host's

V6 no unit test for the stage order: RenderFrameCoordinator::record needs a live device and swapchain, and the callback version was untested for the same reason. The added static_assert only pins the plan's shape (it holds the interface pointer). The order's verifiability comes from being one function with five steps, recorded in progress.md so it is not mistaken for covered

V6 evidence: rg for std::function in RenderFrameInputs.h and FrameRecordExtensions.h is empty (PresentationGraphService keeps only the init-time viewportDisplayImageProvider, which is not per-frame behavior); rg for the old names (DisplayComposeInput, recordModuleViewportCompose, recordModulePresentation, recordBeforeExtensions, recordExtensions(), appendCapture) finds only the new ones; ya-render-3d-test 176/176; the ya-testing render/editor filter is 265 passed / 3 failed, identical to the V1-V5 baseline; both smoke screenshots are byte-identical (runtime md5 1c6668976be1cdd5d755d1f1365700f7, editor md5 5b8f5dd8acdbc90bd5c383feb3f7bcec) and both runs pass --screenshot, so the moved appendDisplayCapture stage really executed, as did the editor's onBeforePresentation and onPresentation
V7-V8 landed 2026-09-19: the offscreen pump is a named step and the viewport debug catalog left the device

V7 the one-line OffscreenTaskService::tick call inside tickRender became GameRuntimeTickOrchestrator::pumpOffscreenTasks with a profile scope and a comment in both tickRender and the header saying why it is a pre-record prerequisite: the previous tick's submission is fenced and finalized here, and jobs queued this tick are recorded and submitted here but only become readable at the next pump, so it must run before any View preparation reads a derived resource

V7 also deleted RenderDeviceState::isOffscreenPending(), which had zero consumers: the acceptance text asked for 'a consumer of isOffscreenPending() that explains what it waits for', and since there is none the right disposal is deletion, consistent with skill rule 15

V8 RenderDeviceState.ViewportDebug.cpp (652 lines) moved to Render3D/Debug/ViewportDebugCatalogBuilder.{h,cpp} and became a pure function of resolved handles: ViewportDebugCatalogInput holds the pipeline flags, RenderPipelineDebugOutputCatalog, DeferredPipelineDebugViews, brdfLut, environmentLighting, inspectScene and a flattened 36-entry point-shadow face array, and three free functions replaced the three device methods

V8 removed the last std::function-shaped input in that path: the builder used to wrap runtime.getShadowPointFaceDepthResource in a lambda and now reads input.pointShadowFaces[], so the input is data (the same principle as V6)

V8 the mutable cache moved out of the device into ViewportDebugCatalogCache (digest plus catalog), leaving the device a single mutable ViewportDebugCatalogCache member; RenderPipelineDebugOutputCatalog moved from RenderDeviceState.h into the builder header; the device keeps exactly one resolution point, makeViewportDebugCatalogInput(Scene*), which is the only place in this path entitled to read device internals

V8 acceptance deviation, recorded: the plan asked for 'zero hits for ViewportDebug in RenderDeviceState*' and that is neither achieved nor correct, because the device must still name the type at its resolver and at buildViewportSnapshot (the consumer). What is achieved is the substance: the device's public surface no longer has buildViewportDebugCatalog, appendViewportDebugImages, buildViewportDebugCatalogSignature or ensureViewportDebugCatalog, and the 650-line implementation is out of the device's files

V8 not done: the plan's 'also cut the debug/compose part of ya-render-3d -> ya-gui-compose'. Checked and unrelated -- the old debug catalog file did not include GUI/Compose at all; Render2DComposePass.h appears in RenderDeviceState.cpp and RenderFrameCoordinator.cpp for prepareRender2DComposePassPipeline (runtime UI compose pipeline prep), which is compose, not debug. Moving it out needs compose preparation to be called by the host (the editor already calls it itself; the runtime path does not), so it is a separate dependency-boundary change tracked as source-layout-subtraction S2

V7-V8 evidence: ya-render-3d-test 176/176; the ya-testing render/editor filter is 265 passed / 3 failed, identical to the V1-V6 baseline; both smoke screenshots byte-identical (runtime md5 1c6668976be1cdd5d755d1f1365700f7, editor md5 5b8f5dd8acdbc90bd5c383feb3f7bcec); ya-engine, GUIWorkbench, GreedySnake, ya-gui-closure-test, ya-gui-headless-host-test and ya-render-2d-test all build. The identical screenshots mainly prove the move did not touch the render main chain, because the catalog is only consumed by the editor's Debug Images panel, which the smoke runs do not open; catalog equivalence rests on the move being a rename of runtime.X() to input.X, with the only semantic change being the pre-resolved point-shadow array filled by the same getShadowPointFaceDepthResource in the same frame

V1-V8 are now landed; what remains is what the plan placed elsewhere: merging RenderViewRecordingContext into RenderPipelineFrameContext and renaming RenderFrameData to PreparedViewRenderData (P3 naming batch), owner-scoped SceneViewKey (4.0.3 checkpoint 5), and the public Renderer merge (4.0.3 checkpoint 2/3 with the P2 flight rename)
